_comment: Textbook Component Coverage Manifest — machine-readable source of truth for Lyra's Component Coverage analysis. Update this file whenever a new language or card type is added. Lyra reads this at runtime via lyra-analytics-service.ts.
updated_by: automated session — Portuguese complete, inline READ wired

grammar_cards.description: Verb tables, decision trees, sentence-structure diagrams, false cognates, preposition maps

cultural_cards.description: World map, food guide, festival calendar, gesture awareness, currency, dialect map, family tree, greetings

phonetic_guides.description: Vowel purity, consonant sounds, tones, script guides, stress and pitch rules

word_families.description: Hub-and-spoke root→verb/noun/adjective/adverb clusters for high-frequency words

canvas_vocab_cards.description: Interactive vocabulary datasets for the scene canvas (weather, emotions, time, days, body, face, hand, temperature)

hebrew.notes: RTL script language. Phonetic guides cover nikud (vowel marks) and guttural consonants. Grammar cards address gendered verbs, root system (shoresh), and binyanim.

grammar_cards.notes: Noun gender (m/f), definite article ה, present tense (present participle), past tense (pa'al binyan), future tense, negation אין/לא, pronouns, adjective agreement, prepositions (ב/ל/מ/כ prefix), שורש root system, pa'al/pi'el/hif'il binyanim overview, question words, numbers (m/f), possession ל+pronoun, construct state (סמיכות)

cultural_cards.notes: HebrewWorldMapCard (Israel + diaspora), IsraeliCuisineCard, JewishHolidaysCard (ראש השנה/יום כיפור/פסח/חנוכה), SabbathEtiquetteCard, CurrencyCard (שקל), DialectCard (Israeli modern/Mizrahi/Ashkenazi pronunciation), FamilyCard (mishpacha terms)

phonetic_guides.notes: Aleph-Bet chart (22 letters), Final letter forms (ך ם ן ף ץ), Guttural consonants (א/ע/ח/ר), Nikud vowel system, Dagesh (kal vs chazak), Shin/Sin distinction (שׁ/שׂ), Vet/Bet (ב/ב+dagesh), Tsere/Segol vowels, Stress patterns (mil'el vs mil'ra)

word_families.notes: דיבר, אכל, גר, עבד, ישן, טייל, אהב, כתב, קרא, ידע, יכול, שמע — 12 families (largest set; Hebrew root system makes derivations especially rich)

global_notes: Spanish is the baseline/reference language — its grammar split across TextbookGrammarDiagrams.tsx + TextbookInfographics.tsx intentionally provides ~2× the grammar card coverage of other languages.
All canvas vocab datasets (weather/emotions/time/days/body/face/hand/temperature) share a single TextbookCanvasCards.tsx file with per-language dataset branches.
TextbookLessonReader.tsx is now deprecated — content was moved inline to VisualLessonCard in TextbookChapterView.tsx (March 20, 2026). The file is retained for reference.
Lyra should alert if any language drops below the minimum thresholds in card_types[].lyra_alert_below.
Hebrew transliteration convention: always double-quoted strings with apostrophes for aleph/ayin (me'od, na'im, 'ayin). Never single-quoted strings.
